//: e2e/*.ts are ES MODULES, and this three-line file is the only thing that says so. Node (and tsc's NodeNext, and tsx/esbuild) decide a bare `.ts`/`.js` file's module format from the NEAREST enclosing package.json `type` — and this repo has no root manifest, so before this file existed the nearest one was nothing at all, i.e. CommonJS. Every harness here is top-level-await + import.meta, so the .mjs -> .ts conversion failed outright: `Top-level await is currently not supported with the "cjs" output format`. A tsconfig cannot fix it: the format is resolved by the loader, not the compiler. `.mjs` files are unaffected either way (always ESM), so this is additive.
